I don't know how many times we need to have this discussion... eth_ methods are not supported on hive? Hive can do a lot of things. That only leaves a prestate and a poststate??? yes. because there is rawBytes field in the post state and it is already signed and no need to construct vector and calculate indexes Why is it in the poststate?? ``` "post" : { "Berlin" : [ { "indexes" : { "data" : 0, "gas" : 0, "value" : 0 }, "hash" : "0x92575ea202220f5f34292941b2ed9d6821c29f221d3ea417682b872d18094c55", "txbytes" : "", "logs" : "0x1dcc4de8dec75d7aab85b567b6ccd41ad312451b948a7413f0a142fd40d49347" }, ```` Ah, I see but I assume it might break many executors. it kind of handy if devs are only using the filled test they can human read the rlp content but again the indexes I think we should keep the transaction. Why do you think it needs any change? My testcase above shows that it's already working fine I think is worth indicating explicitly that a transaction is expected to be rejected.
